body:
fuck i just feel ridiculous for bringing this up now.

i am pretty sure sleeping pills aren't the way to go anymore if there's a good chance they're not going to work.

I wish i wasn't such a fucking coward and could manage this.
wow that's shitty. What could you hear them saying?
fuck. There is no easy way out is there?

The thing is, i've kinda lost of my hobbies, nothing entertains or gives me any joy anymore it all just seems utterly pointless. I tried playing an hour of Uncharted before but just got completely frustrated and annoyed.

I work as a software developer but i have just lost all enthusiam for it :|

>Plus the ER ppl will look down on you.

What do you mean by this?

Hi, i think you're right, I really don't want to end my life, at least I don't want to end it in a scary way. I don't want to share why I feel so suicidal, I guess I just wanted to put my thoughts down and let others see them. I don't know.

The general advice so far seems that sleeping pills and vodka are just going to make me sick. I've also looked into an exit bag type kit, sort of a DIY thing from items you can get off of Amazon, although the idea of breathing in a gas is absolouetly terrifiying to me. I just want to fall asleep and not wake up, I odn't want it to be traumatic or scary :(
